subtitle: Rock Star

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello?
dialogue.zh: 喂？

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna, this is Ms. Weaver.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，我是韋弗女士。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Ms. Weaver!
dialogue.zh: 韋弗女士！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Tomorrow, you’ll be interviewing musician Emma G.
dialogue.zh: 明天，你將採訪音樂家 Emma G。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Emma G?! I will be talking to Emma G?!
dialogue.zh: Emma G？！我要跟 Emma G 談話？！

dialogue.speaker: Ms. Weaver
dialogue.en: Anna? Anna, are you there?
dialogue.zh: 安娜？安娜，你還在嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Professor Bot
dialogue.en: Anna and Ms. Weaver used the future continuous verb tense to talk about the interview. We use future continuous to talk about actions that will be in progress at or around a time in the future. For example, Ms. Weaver says, “Tomorrow, you’ll be interviewing musician Emma G.” There are two options for future continuous. The first is: will be + the -ing form of the verb. And the second is: be + going to be + the -ing form of the verb. Keep watching for more!
dialogue.zh: 安娜和韋弗女士用將來進行時來談這次採訪。將來進行時用來表示將來某個時間正在進行的動作。比如韋弗女士說：“Tomorrow, you’ll be interviewing musician Emma G.” 將來進行時有兩種形式。第一種：will be + 動詞的 -ing 形式。第二種：be + going to be + 動詞的 -ing 形式。繼續看！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello and welcome to The Music! Today, musician Emma G will be joining us here!
dialogue.zh: 大家好，歡迎來到 The Music！今天，音樂家 Emma G 將來到這裡！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: She is a wonderful songwriter and an amazing singer. And I love her! Let’s give a warm welcome to Emma G!
dialogue.zh: 她是出色的詞曲作者，也是了不起的歌手。而且我超愛她！讓我們熱烈歡迎 Emma G！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hi. Thank you for coming on the show, Emma G.
dialogue.zh: 嗨。謝謝你來上節目，Emma G。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Of course. It’s great to be here.
dialogue.zh: 當然。很高興來到這裡。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Well, we can’t wait to hear you sing. I listen to your music a lot. So, I feel like I know you. Is that strange?
dialogue.zh: 我們等不及聽你唱歌了。我經常聽你的歌。所以感覺好像認識你。這奇怪嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Anna, listening to music can be a very personal experience. So, no, that’s not strange.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，聽音樂可以是很個人的體驗。所以，不，這不奇怪。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good because I made something for you -- a video scrapbook of our friendship.
dialogue.zh: 那就好，因為我給你做了個東西——我們友誼的影片剪貼簿。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I took photos of you and added myself. I worked on it all weekend.
dialogue.zh: 我用了你的照片，再把自己加進去。我做了整整一個週末。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Well, that -- that’s strange. Is that even -- is that even legal?
dialogue.zh: 嗯，那——那有點奇怪。這甚至——這合法嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Now, Emma, let’s talk about your schedule. Tell me ... I mean, tell us exactly where you will be and when. Exactly.
dialogue.zh: 好，Emma，我們來談談你的行程。告訴我……我是說，準確地告訴我們你什麼時候會在哪裡。準確的。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Sure. Well, in early June, I’ll be performing at several venues across Austin, Texas.
dialogue.zh: 好。六月初，我將在得克薩斯州奧斯汀的幾個場地演出。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s my vacation week. I can meet you there! We can tour the city. We can have lunch.
dialogue.zh: 那是我的假期周。我可以去那兒見你！我們可以逛城市。我們可以吃午飯。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Um, yeah maybe. Then in mid-July, I’m going to be teaching at a music camp in Chicago.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也許吧。然後七月中旬，我將在芝加哥的一個音樂營教課。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’ll be visiting my sister then. She only lives about six hours from Chicago! I could drive over. We could hang out.
dialogue.zh: 那時我會去看我姐姐。她住的地方離芝加哥大概六個小時！我可以開車過去。我們可以一起玩。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Yeah, uh maybe. You know, maybe now is a good time for some music.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，也許吧。你知道，也許現在適合來點音樂。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: That’s a great idea. Now, let's hear a song from Emma G.!
dialogue.zh: 好主意。現在，來聽 Emma G. 的一首歌！

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: I wrote this song a couple of years ago. It’s called “Wary.”
dialogue.zh: 這首歌是我幾年前寫的。叫《Wary》。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Do you believe in happy endings?
dialogue.zh: 你相信圓滿結局嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Endings...
dialogue.zh: 結局……

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Do you really believe that we could be…
dialogue.zh: 你真的相信我們能……

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Be...

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: I think something is wrong. I hear a voice in the background.
dialogue.zh: 我覺得有點不對。我聽到背景裡有個聲音。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Sorry. Sorry, Emma. That was me. I’m just so excited.
dialogue.zh: 抱歉。抱歉，Emma。是我。我實在太興奮了。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: No problem. I'm glad you like the song.
dialogue.zh: 沒關係。我很高興你喜歡這首歌。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You go ahead. You go ahead.
dialogue.zh: 你繼續。你繼續。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Okay. Do you believe in happy endings?
dialogue.zh: 好。你相信圓滿結局嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Anna, there’s no tambourine in this.
dialogue.zh: 安娜，這首歌沒有鈴鼓。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I’m so sorry. I’m so sorry, Emma. See, I’ve always wanted to sing with you.
dialogue.zh: 真對不起。真對不起，Emma。你看，我一直想跟你一起唱。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Well, come on over then and we can sing a song together first.
dialogue.zh: 那過來吧，我們先一起唱一首。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No, I couldn't.
dialogue.zh: 不，我不行。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Come on. It’ll be fun.
dialogue.zh: 來嘛。會很好玩的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Okay! Here. I brought my favorite song.
dialogue.zh: 好！給。我帶了我最喜歡的歌。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Oh, uh okay. Actually, I like this song. Um, are you ready?
dialogue.zh: 哦，嗯好。其實我喜歡這首歌。準備好了嗎？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Yes! Yes!
dialogue.zh: 好了！好了！

dialogue.speaker: Emma G
dialogue.en: Okay.
dialogue.zh: 好。

dialogue.speaker: Emma G / Anna
dialogue.en: Every breath you take. Every move you make. Every bond you break. Every step you take. I'll be watching you … I’ll be watching you... I’ll be watching you...
dialogue.zh: 你的每一次呼吸。你的每一個動作。你打破的每一段關係。你的每一步。我都會看著你……我都會看著你……我都會看著你……

quiz.prompt: Who will Anna be interviewing tomorrow?
What does Anna make for Emma G?
choices: A video scrapbook of their friendship

quiz.prompt: What does Anna do during Emma G’s song “Wary”?
choices: She sings and plays tambourine in the background
